pairs.english: One household wanted to take broken coal instead;

Sela separated the two shares,

pairs.target: zhǔnbèi míngtiān zhī lǐng yuànyì huàn de nà fèn .
pairs.english: planning to collect only the willing household's share tomorrow.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèng ná xiǎodāo guā huài jiāzi de máobiān .
pairs.english: Tavi was scraping a burr off the broken clip with a small knife.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维正拿小刀刮坏夹子的毛边。

pairs.english: Seeing Nerai look his way,
he hastily opened both hands.
“I wasn't practising.

“Then scrape away.”
She took the clip,

pairs.target: duì zhe ménwài shèngxià de guāng kàn le kàn ,
pairs.english: examined it in the remaining light outside the door,

pairs.target: " míngtiān yǒu yìpī jiù kòujiàn yào qù xiù .
pairs.english: “There's a batch of old fasteners to clean rust off tomorrow.

pairs.english: That work you asked about last time for your coworker—
I remembered.

Let him come and discuss it himself.”
Tavi nodded,

pairs.target: xiǎnxiē xiān tì nà rén dāying .
pairs.english: almost accepting on the man's behalf.
Nerai did not leave at once.

pairs.target: sè lā wǎng zào lǐ tiān le liǎnggēn xì chái ,
pairs.english: Sela added two thin sticks to the stove
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉往灶里添了两根细柴，

pairs.english: and asked whether she had eaten.
“I have.”
“Then tell us what's on your mind.

pairs.target: nǐ bǎ dèngzǐ zuò dé zhème zhèng ,
pairs.english: You're sitting so straight on that stool,
it's tiring to watch.”
Nerai laughed

pairs.target: jiāng gē zài xītóu de shǒu sōngkāi .
pairs.english: and relaxed the hands resting on her knees.
“I wanted to ask Tavi

pairs.english: whether he'd like to study at the White Steps academy.”
pairs.hanzi: 愿不愿意去白阶学宫学。”

pairs.english: The knife was still in his hand.

pairs.target: gāngcái guāxià de tiěxiè niánzhe mǔzhǐ ,
pairs.english: The iron shavings he'd just scraped off clung to his thumb.

pairs.english: He rubbed them twice with a fingertip

pairs.english: before the name of the place she had mentioned sank in.

pairs.target: tā jiàn guò bái jiē de xuéshēng .
pairs.english: He had seen students from the White Steps.
In winter,

pairs.english: in their case was a lamp that wind could not put out.

pairs.target: nàshí tā tì tāmen fú guò chǐ .

“Study property borrowing?”

pairs.target: " yě xué rèn liào , huàtú , suàn zàizhòng .

When something breaks,
you need to know why.

pairs.english: There are lessons I can't teach here.”
pairs.hanzi: 有些课我在这里教不了。”

pairs.english: “The people there—
can they all borrow properties?”
“Some can.
Some do other things.

pairs.target: yízuò qiáo búshì yì shuāngshǒu dā qǐlái de . "
pairs.english: A bridge takes more than one pair of hands to build.”
pairs.hanzi: 一座桥不是一双手搭起来的。”

pairs.english: He remembered the day he'd held the rule:

pairs.english: one student lay on the ground writing numbers,
pairs.hanzi: 一个学生趴在地上写数，

that he couldn't see the markings at all.

pairs.english: The two argued through the brick wall for ages.

pairs.english: He'd secretly laughed then:
all that reading,

pairs.english: and they argued just as much as his own lot.
Thinking back now,

pairs.english: he hadn't even understood what they were arguing about.
pairs.hanzi: 他连他们争的是什么都没听懂，

pairs.english: He only remembered not daring to let go,

pairs.english: afraid the long rule would fall into the ash.
“You teach there?”
“I've taught field classes.

So the mud on them

pairs.english: “We can't afford it.”
“I know.”

pairs.english: I can vouch for him

If you pass the assessment,

pairs.english: the bursary covers tuition, accommodation and shared tools.

you pay any extra yourself.

pairs.english: he remembered that people beneath lamps still had to eat.

he asked.

pairs.target: nǐ bùnéng zhī tiāo tóng jiē chéng . "

pairs.hanzi: 我现在不能替他们许诺。”

This sheet isn't enough.”

pairs.english: “This line,

“Why would you vouch for me?”

I can't be the one teaching you
